name: Aquaguard Aspire SlimTech UV
summary: Aquaguard Aspire Slimtech is an ultra-slim premium UV water purifier designed for municipal water supply. Equipped with 9-stage purification, NanoPore Long-Life Filter Technology, 3-in-1 Active Copper Technology, and a 2-year filter life, it delivers safe, healthy, and mineral-enriched drinking water.
intro: Aquaguard Aspire Slimtech is a premium, ultra-slim UV water purifier designed for modern homes with municipal water supply. Featuring NanoPore Long-Life Filter Technology, 9-stage purification, 3-in-1 Active Copper Technology, and a 2-year filter life, it delivers safe, healthy, mineral-enriched drinking water. Its sleek toughened glass design, 5th Gen UV LED purification, and free first-year service make it an ideal blend of style, performance, and convenience.
features: Ultra-slim premium design with toughened glass finish
9-stage purification for superior protection against bacteria, viruses, and contaminants
NanoPore Long-Life Filter Technology with up to 2-year / 12,000 L filter life
3-in-1 Active Copper Technology enriches water with Copper, Calcium & Magnesium
5th Gen UV LED technology for instant, mercury-free purification
Mega Sediment Filter protects internal filters and improves durability
4-litre storage tank for uninterrupted water supply
Free installation, 2 cleaning visits, and unlimited repairs in the first year
Ideal for municipal water sources with TDS up to 200 mg/L
